<p align="center"><strong>Find the brass key to the attic.</strong></p>


<p align="center">The front door closes without touching its frame. A staircase leads to a locked attic. To your left, a candle burns in the study. Your muddy footprints continue across the floor several steps ahead of you.</p>

<p align="center">The caretaker calls himself Elias. A black cat hisses at the shadow behind him. Elias has no body solid enough to cast one.</p>

<p align="center">&quot;The study key. Then the autumn bell,&quot; he says. &quot;And whatever you hear outside, do not say trick or treat back.&quot;</p>
